title: Quick Energizing Chinese Ricotta Skewers
description: A high protein Cantonese dish featuring ricotta and robata grill, perfect for a quick snack or appetizer. This dish combines the creaminess of ricotta with the savory flavor of Chinese ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sesame oil, soy sauce, and honey until well combined.
Add the crumbled ricotta cheese to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Thread a small amount of the ricotta mixture onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the remaining sesame oil mixture.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
